projects.title: VisionInspect
projects.description: Real-time defect detection for manufacturing lines using a custom CNN trained on production imagery.
projects.challenges: Low-light factory footage produced noisy, inconsistent detections.
projects.solution: Built a preprocessing pipeline with adaptive histogram equalization and trained an ensemble of lightweight CNNs, cutting false positives by 68%.

projects.title: Ledgerly
projects.description: Multi-tenant accounting platform serving 40+ SMB clients with real-time reconciliation.
projects.challenges: Needed strict tenant isolation without duplicating infrastructure cost.
projects.solution: Designed a schema-per-tenant SQL Server strategy with a shared ASP.NET Core API layer and row-level caching.

projects.title: TrailMap
projects.description: A social trip-planning app for hikers and travelers, with collaborative itineraries and offline maps.
projects.challenges: Rendering thousands of trail geometries without freezing the map on mobile.
projects.solution: Implemented tile-based clustering and a custom Web Worker for geometry simplification.

projects.title: opencommit-cli
projects.description: A CLI that writes conventional commit messages from your staged diff using an LLM.
projects.challenges: Keeping generated messages concise and accurate across large diffs.
projects.solution: Chunked diffs semantically and summarized hierarchically before the final generation pass.

projects.title: Pulse CRM
projects.description: Lightweight CRM built for a logistics startup to replace a spreadsheet-based workflow.
projects.challenges: Sales team needed offline-first support for field visits with spotty connectivity.
projects.solution: Added an IndexedDB-backed sync layer with conflict resolution reconciled against PostgreSQL.

projects.title: FocusLens
projects.description: Webcam-based posture and focus tracker for remote workers, entirely on-device.
projects.challenges: Needed real-time inference in-browser without sending video anywhere.
projects.solution: Ported the detection model to run via WASM, keeping all processing client-side for privacy.

workPrinciples.title: Ship small, ship often
workPrinciples.detail: Small, reviewable changes beat big-bang releases every time.

workPrinciples.title: Tests aren't optional
workPrinciples.detail: If it's worth shipping, it's worth a test that fails when it breaks.

workPrinciples.title: Documentation is a feature
workPrinciples.detail: Code nobody can onboard onto is code that slows the whole team down.

workPrinciples.title: Boring technology wins
workPrinciples.detail: Reach for the exciting new tool only when the boring one actually can't do it.
